# Quickstart: Public Landing Page

**Feature**: `001-landing-page` | **Date**: 2026-11-13

This guide is for implementation and verification of the landing page. It assumes the feature plan has been implemented. It does not replace the specification or the contracts.

## Prerequisites

- Node.js compatible with the project's Next.js 16 setup.
- Dependencies installed from the repository root of the client app.
- Read `AGENTS.md` before changing Next.js code. This project uses Next.js 16 conventions (`proxy.ts`, `preload` instead of `priority`).
- Do not commit secrets or a real backend URL in `.env.local`.

## Install and Run

From `src/client`:

```powershell
npm install
npm run dev
```

Open `http://localhost:3000`.

Quality gates:

```powershell
npm run lint
npm run build
npm test
```

`npm test` is available after the test-tooling task adds Vitest and the test scripts. Until then, use `npm run lint` and `npm run build`, and run the manual checks below.

## Mock Configuration

Create an untracked `.env.local` for local verification:

```dotenv
NEXT_PUBLIC_DATA_SOURCE=mock
NEXT_PUBLIC_MOCK_ACTIVITY_SCENARIO=success
NEXT_PUBLIC_MOCK_AUTH_STATE=student
```

| Variable | Values | Purpose |
|----------|--------|---------|
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_DATA_SOURCE` | `mock` (default), `api` | Selects the activity service implementation |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_MOCK_ACTIVITY_SCENARIO` | `success`, `partial`, `empty`, `error`, `delay`, `single-list`, `all-invalid`, `long-content` | Selects deterministic activity fixtures |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_MOCK_AUTH_STATE` | `guest`, `student`, `organizer`, `admin` | Optional mock-auth QA scenario; default preserves the existing signed-in mock behavior |

`NEXT_PUBLIC_*` values are embedded at build time. Restart the dev server after changing them.

### Real service configuration

When the backend contract is confirmed:

```dotenv
NEXT_PUBLIC_DATA_SOURCE=api
NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=https://your-confirmed-api.example
```

Do not enable this until the endpoint, response envelope, field names, and image host are confirmed. If activity images are remote, add the confirmed host to `images.remotePatterns`; do not use a broad allowlist.

## Verification Matrix

### 1. Static page and composition

1. Open `/` with activities in `delay` mode.
2. Confirm the header, hero, highlights, help, and footer render before the activity request completes.
3. Confirm there is exactly one `h1`, section titles are `h2`, and card titles are `h3`.
4. Confirm the six sections appear in order: Hero, Highlights, Activities, Services, Help, Footer.
5. Confirm the page metadata title, description, and social preview are present.
6. Confirm the footer copyright year matches the current year and is not a hardcoded value.

### 2. Guest behavior

1. Set `NEXT_PUBLIC_MOCK_AUTH_STATE=guest`.
2. Confirm the header shows Log In and reserves its space without a Dashboard flash.
3. Confirm Get Started opens `/login` and, after successful sign-in, lands on the role dashboard.
4. Confirm header Log In from the services area returns to `/#services` after sign-in.
5. Confirm public services are usable and authenticated-only services are blurred, inert, unselectable, and absent from the accessibility tree.
6. Confirm there is no ΓÇ£Log in to see all servicesΓÇ¥ overlay.

### 3. Signed-in behavior

1. Set the mock auth state to `student`, then repeat for `organizer` and `admin`.
2. Confirm `/` does not redirect away.
3. Confirm the header shows Dashboard and links to the correct role dashboard.
4. Confirm all services are visible and usable.
5. Confirm Get Started goes directly to the role dashboard.

### 4. Activity states

Use the mock scenario variable and reload `/` for each case:

| Scenario | Expected |
|----------|----------|
| `success` | Two featured cards on the left and three compact cards on the right on wide screens |
| `partial` | Invalid records are omitted; valid records still render |
| `empty` | Empty message with reserved height; no empty grid |
| `error` | Error message and Try again; the rest of the page remains usable |
| `delay` | Skeleton persists; header and other sections remain usable |
| `single-list` | Up to five featured-style cards, at most three columns |
| `all-invalid` | Error outcome; no broken cards |
| `long-content` | Four-line featured title clamp, three-line compact clamp, multi-day date, missing optional fields omitted, image fallback |

Retry:

1. Start in `error`.
2. Activate Try again repeatedly.
3. Confirm the section enters loading and ends in exactly one success, empty, or error outcome with no duplicate content.

### 5. Navigation

1. Click each header link; confirm the section lands below the floating header and the URL hash updates.
2. Scroll through the page; confirm the active link updates and uses more than color.
3. Open `/#services` directly; confirm the services section is positioned correctly after images/fonts finish loading.
4. Use browser Back and Forward; confirm the previous/next section is restored.
5. Open the brand; confirm it returns to the top.

### 6. Mobile drawer

Use a viewport below 1024px:

1. Open the menu; confirm it is modal, contains all section links and the auth action, and locks page scrolling.
2. Press Tab repeatedly; confirm focus stays inside the drawer.
3. Press Escape; confirm the drawer closes and focus returns to the menu trigger.
4. Activate the backdrop; confirm the drawer closes and focus returns to the trigger.
5. Select a section; confirm the drawer closes and the page moves to that section.

### 7. Responsive layout

Check at 320, 375, 640, 768, 1024, 1440, and 1920 pixels wide.

- 320ΓÇô639: one column for highlights, services, and guides; hero actions stack; compact activities stay horizontal.
- 640ΓÇô1023: header uses the menu; highlights and services use two columns; guides use two columns; featured activities use two columns; compact activities form a two-column stack below.
- 1024+: three highlight columns; 3x2 services; 2x2 guides; featured/compact activity arrangement as designed.
- No horizontal scrolling at any width.
- Touch targets are at least 44x44px.

### 8. Accessibility

1. Navigate the entire page by keyboard; every interactive element is reachable in a logical order with visible focus.
2. Confirm the activity section announces loading/empty/error without moving focus.
3. Confirm status labels include text and are not color-only.
4. Confirm decorative images/shapes are hidden and content images have meaningful alternatives.
5. Confirm the mobile drawer excludes the rest of the page from keyboard and screen-reader navigation.
6. Enable reduced motion; confirm scrolling is immediate, hover lift is suppressed, and skeleton pulse is disabled.
7. Run `axe-core` checks (once the test helper exists) and review the report for critical violations.
8. Check text contrast at WCAG 2.1 AA, especially the hero headline over the campus image and white text on the deep-blue services/footer backgrounds.

### 9. Images and resilience

1. Force the hero image to fail; confirm the layout remains intact and the text stays readable.
2. Force an activity image to fail; confirm the branded placeholder preserves card dimensions.
3. Use an invalid image URL in a mock fixture; confirm no layout shift.
4. Throttle the network; confirm the activity skeleton does not block the rest of the page.

### 10. Activity contract edge cases

1. A single ordered list is treated as upcoming and rendered in the featured style.
2. A single list after grouped placeholders may reflow without clipping, overlap, or horizontal scrolling.
3. An activity with no categories or location omits those lines without punctuation artifacts.
4. A multi-day activity displays both dates and times in `Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh`.
5. A title with Vietnamese text renders exactly as supplied, with no case transformation.
6. Extra featured/upcoming items are ignored beyond the display caps.

## Automated Test Targets

Once the test tooling is installed:

```powershell
npm test
npm run test:watch
```

Expected coverage:

- `formatActivityTime` timezone, same-day, multi-day, midnight, and invalid input.
- `getDashboardPath`, `getLoginHref`, and safe redirect validation, including open-redirect rejection.
- `activity.mapper` grouped/single-list shapes, invalid-item skipping, all-invalid errors, caps, href encoding, and title preservation.
- Real/mock activity service contract, API path/signal use, and error propagation.
- `useLandingActivities` loading/success/empty/error, retry, abort, stale-response protection, and mapper-error handling.
- `ActivitiesSection` state rendering, retry, and announcements.
- `ActivityGrid` layout rules.
- `ActivityCard` links, clamps, optional fields, image fallback, and status text.
- `HeroActions` guest/authenticated/loading targets.
- `ServicesSection` guest/authenticated/loading gating.
- `SiteHeader` auth actions, role dashboard path, mobile dialog, and active section.
- `GuideCard` available/unavailable destinations.
- `axe-core` checks for key client renders.

## Known Limitations and Release Dependencies

- The activity endpoint, envelope, and field names are provisional. Do not enable the real service until the backend confirms them.
- The real media host is unknown; remote activity images require a confirmed image allowlist.
- Two service names/icons, final hero wording, help destinations, and footer copy are pending.
- `/help` may not exist; guide cards whose destinations are unavailable must render as unavailable, not dead links.
- The existing auth mock auto-authenticates a test student. Guest-state manual QA depends on the optional mock-auth scenario; otherwise use component tests and the real backend.
- The existing proxy has an unrelated authenticated-`/login` redirect issue; avoid expanding this feature into a proxy refactor.
- Next.js 16 uses `preload`, not `priority`, for the hero image.
- Do not add a new runtime dependency for this feature; test dependencies are dev-only and justified in the plan.

1: import { NAVIGATION_ITEMS } from '@/libs/navigation';
2: import { ROLE_CODES, ROLE_RULES } from '@/libs/roles';
3: import { decrypt } from '@/libs/session';
4: import { NextResponse, NextRequest } from 'next/server'
5: 
6: 
7: export async function proxy(request: NextRequest) {
8:   console.log('proxy called', request.url);
9: 
10:   const { pathname } = request.nextUrl;
11:   const rule = ROLE_RULES.find((r) => pathname.startsWith(r.prefix));
12:   const rawSession = request.cookies.get('session')?.value;
13:   const session = await decrypt(rawSession);
14: 
15:   if (rule) {
16:     if (!session) {
17:       console.log('No session found, redirecting to login');
18:       return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/login', request.url));
19:     }
20:     if (!rule.roles.includes(session.role)) {
21:       console.log('User role not authorized for this route, redirecting to forbidden');
22:       return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/forbiden', request.url));
23:     }
24:   }
25: 
26:   if (session && pathname.startsWith('/login')) {
27:     NAVIGATION_ITEMS[session.role].forEach((item) => {
28:       if (item.label === 'Dashboard') {
29:         console.log('User already logged in, redirecting to dashboard');
30:         return NextResponse.redirect(new URL(item.href, request.url));
31:       }
32:     }
33:     )
34:   }
35: 
36:   console.log('User authorized, proceeding to next route');
37:   return NextResponse.next();
38: }
39:

**Organization**: The user requested five logical phases. This task list preserves those phases while using user-story phases for independent delivery slices. Phase 1 and Phase 2 are shared foundation; Phases 3-7 are user stories in priority order; Phase 8 is integration; Phase 9 is quality assurance. All paths are relative to `src/client`.

## Format: `[ID] [P?] [Story] Description`

- **[P]**: Can run in parallel with other [P] tasks in the same phase; different files and no incomplete dependency.
- **[Story]**: `[US1]` through `[US5]`, matching `spec.md`.
- Every task includes an exact file path and a verification or acceptance condition.

## Path Conventions

- Single Next.js application rooted at `src/client`.
- Application code: `src/`.
- Shared test harness: `tests/`.
- Feature code: `src/features/<feature>/`.
- Static assets: `public/images/`.

# Tasks: Public Landing Page

**Input**: Design documents from `/specs/001-landing-page/`

**Prerequisites**: `plan.md`, `spec.md`, `research.md`, `data-model.md`, `contracts/`, `quickstart.md`

**Tests**: Included because the implementation plan and source specification explicitly require deterministic verification of formatting, mapping, activity states, service gating, grid behavior, navigation, and accessibility. Test tasks precede the implementation they validate where practical.

**Organization**: The user requested five logical phases. This list preserves those phases while using user-story phases for independent delivery slices. Phase 1 and Phase 2 are shared foundation; Phases 3-7 are user stories in priority order; Phase 8 is integration; Phase 9 is quality assurance. All paths are relative to `src/client`.

## Format: `[ID] [P?] [Story] Description`

- **[P]**: Can run in parallel with other [P] tasks in the same phase; different files and no incomplete dependency.
- **[Story]**: `[US1]` through `[US5]`, matching `spec.md`.
- Every task includes an exact file path and a verification or acceptance condition.

## Path Conventions

- Single Next.js application rooted at `src/client`.
- Application code: `src/`.
- Shared test harness: `tests/`.
- Feature code: `src/features/<feature>/`.
- Static assets: `public/images/`.

---

## Phase 1: Project and Shared Foundation

**Purpose**: Establish test tooling, shared contracts, tokens, utilities, and the auth-state prerequisite used by all stories.

- [ ] T001 Add development-only test tooling and scripts to `package.json`: `vitest`, `@vitejs/plugin-react`, `jsdom`, `vite-tsconfig-paths`, `@testing-library/react`, `@testing-library/jest-dom`, `@testing-library/user-event`, `axe-core`; add `"test": "vitest run"` and `"test:watch": "vitest"`. Verify `npm install` succeeds and `npm test -- --passWithNoTests` runs. Covers plan Testing Strategy.
- [ ] T002 [P] Create `vitest.config.ts` with the React plugin, `jsdom` environment, `vite-tsconfig-paths`, `tests/setup.ts`, and test-file patterns. Verify `npm test -- --passWithNoTests` loads the config. Covers plan Testing Strategy.
- [ ] T003 [P] Create `tests/setup.ts` with jest-dom matchers and jsdom shims for `matchMedia`, `IntersectionObserver`, `scrollIntoView`, `HTMLDialogElement.showModal`, and `HTMLDialogElement.close`; add shared mocks for `next/image` and `next/navigation` only where required. Verify a trivial render test passes. Covers plan Testing Strategy.
- [ ] T004 [P] Create `tests/test-utils.tsx` with a typed render helper and `expectNoA11yViolations` using `axe-core`. Verify the helper can render a simple component without importing feature internals. Covers FR-063 through FR-070 and SC-008.
- [ ] T005 [P] Create `src/types/navigation.ts` with `SectionId` (`home`, `about`, `activities`, `services`, `help`, `contact`) and `NavigationLink` (`id`, `label`, `href: \`#${SectionId}\``); create `src/types/site.ts` with `FooterContent` (`brandDescription`, `contactHeading`, `address`, `phones`, `email`, `quickLinksHeading`, `quickLinks`). Verify `tsc` accepts the shapes from `data-model.md`. Covers FR-003, FR-054, and FR-072.
- [ ] T006 [P] Extend `src/libs/api-client.ts` so `api.get<T>(endpoint, options?)` accepts `Omit<RequestOptions, "body" | "method">`, forwards `signal`, and preserves base URL, header, and error normalization; replace touched `any` with `unknown` where safe. Verify a test double confirms the `AbortSignal` reaches `fetch`. Covers Constitution III and plan API Integration Strategy.
- [ ] T007 [P] Add landing design tokens to `src/app/globals.css` through the Tailwind `@theme` layer: primary `#1F4FA3`, primary-dark `#17409A`, accent-gold `#F2B31B`, text `#111827`, text-muted `#6B7280`, surface `#FFFFFF`, success `#16A34A`, warning `#D97706`, neutral-status `#6B7280`, guide gradient `#FFFFFF` to `#E3EEFB`, card radius `24px`, pill radius `9999px`, card shadow `0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.10)`, container `1200px`, gutter `24px`, header height `56px`, and a focus-ring token. Verify no new component needs a raw hex value. Covers FR-058 through FR-067 and plan Design Tokens.
- [ ] T008 [P] Wire the existing Geist import in `src/app/layout.tsx` with `Geist({ variable: "--font-geist-sans", subsets: ["latin"] })`, apply its variable class, set the body font from the token layer in `src/app/globals.css`, and remove or neutralize the `prefers-color-scheme: dark` override. Verify the landing renders with Geist and remains light under dark-mode preference. Covers FR-066 and plan Typography.
- [ ] T009 [P] Add `src/libs/format.test.ts` covering same-day `dd/MM/yyyy, H:mm - H:mm`, multi-day `dd/MM/yyyy H:mm - dd/MM/yyyy H:mm`, midnight, leading-zero minutes, Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh boundary, and invalid dates. Verify the tests fail before T010. Covers FR-034.
- [ ] T010 [P] Implement `src/libs/format.ts` with `formatActivityTime(start: Date, end: Date): string` using `Intl.DateTimeFormat` and `formatToParts` in `Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh`, 24-hour, non-padded hour, and two-digit minutes. Verify T009 passes. Covers FR-034.
- [ ] T011 [P] Add `src/libs/navigation.test.ts` covering `getDashboardPath` for student/organizer/admin, `getLoginHref` encoding, valid landing return paths, and rejection of absolute URLs, protocol-relative URLs, backslashes, control characters, and `/login`. Verify the tests fail before T012. Covers FR-007, FR-008, and FR-015.
- [ ] T012 [P] Add `getDashboardPath(role)`, `getLoginHref(returnTo?)`, and `isSafeRedirectPath(value)` to `src/libs/navigation.ts`, resolving dashboard paths from `NAVIGATION_ITEMS` and returning a role dashboard fallback for invalid values. Verify T011 passes. Covers FR-007, FR-008, and FR-015.
- [ ] T013 [P] Create `src/libs/service-mode.ts` exposing a single mock/API selection helper based on `NEXT_PUBLIC_DATA_SOURCE`, defaulting to `mock`. Verify no component or hook reads the environment variable directly. Covers plan Selection and Mock Strategy.
- [ ] T014 [P] Fix the stale `useMemo` dependencies in `src/features/auth/provider/AuthProvider.tsx` so `isLoading` and `refreshUser` are included. Verify a consumer observes loading-to-guest/authenticated changes without remounting. Covers FR-009 and FR-047.
- [ ] T015 [P] Add the optional `NEXT_PUBLIC_MOCK_AUTH_STATE=guest|student|organizer|admin` scenario to `src/features/auth/services/mock.auth.service.ts`, defaulting to `student` to preserve current behavior; guest must reject `getMe()` so `AuthProvider` clears the user. Verify the existing scratch `src/app/test/page.tsx` still renders `LoginForm` without a redirect prop. Covers FR-009, FR-047, and quickstart guest QA.
- [ ] T016 [P] Add local landing assets under `public/images/landing/`: `hero.*`, `highlight-activities.*`, `highlight-journey.*`, `highlight-campus.*`, and `activity-placeholder.*`; reuse `public/images/hcmus-campus.png` or approved source assets, do not use remote Unsplash URLs, and reserve image dimensions. Verify the files exist and are referenced only through config. Covers FR-017, FR-035, FR-074, and FR-075.

**Checkpoint**: Foundation ready. Test harness, shared types, API options, tokens, formatter, navigation helpers, service mode, auth-loading fix, and local assets exist.

---

## Phase 2: Reusable UI Components

**Purpose**: Build token-backed primitives and site chrome that every landing section reuses.

- [ ] T017 [P] Create `src/components/ui/Button.tsx` and `src/components/ui/Button.test.tsx`: variants `primary | secondary | white | ghost`, sizes `sm | md | lg`, `href` rendering through `next/link`, `isLoading` with `aria-busy`, disabled links not focusable, and token-backed focus rings. Verify the test covers link/button/disabled/loading. Covers UI contract `Button` and FR-062/FR-064.
- [ ] T018 [P] Create `src/components/ui/Container.tsx` and `src/components/ui/Section.tsx`: container max-width/gutter from tokens; semantic `<section>` with optional `id`, `labelledBy`, `background="none|primary-dark"`, and `scroll-margin-top` from the header-height token. Verify anchors land below the floating header. Covers FR-003, FR-012, and FR-063.
- [ ] T019 [P] Create `src/components/ui/SectionHeader.tsx` with `id`, `eyebrow`, `title` rendered as `h2`, optional `description`, `align="left|center|split"`, and `tone="light|dark"`. Verify split alignment stacks on narrow screens and dark tone uses on-primary tokens. Covers FR-063 and plan Responsive Design.
- [ ] T020 [P] Create `src/components/ui/Badge.tsx` and `src/components/ui/Tag.tsx`: badge tones `success | warning | neutral | info`, optional decorative dot hidden from assistive technology, always-visible text; tag is a non-interactive small label. Verify status is never color-only. Covers FR-032 and FR-070.
- [ ] T021 [P] Create `src/components/ui/Skeleton.tsx`, `src/components/ui/EmptyState.tsx`, and `src/components/ui/ErrorState.tsx`: decorative pulse block with `aria-hidden` and `motion-reduce:animate-none`; empty state with optional icon/title/description/action; error state with fixed copy and a real retry button that never renders raw server text. Verify the retry button has a visible focus ring. Covers FR-037, FR-038, FR-067, and FR-068.
- [ ] T022 [P] Create `src/components/ui/SurfaceCard.tsx` with a token-backed white surface, card radius, shadow, and optional guide gradient. Verify it adds no link or role by itself. Covers UI contract `SurfaceCard`.
- [ ] T023 [P] Add one icon per file in `src/components/icons/`: `ArrowRightIcon.tsx`, `CalendarIcon.tsx`, `LocationIcon.tsx`, `LockIcon.tsx`, `MenuIcon.tsx`, and `CloseIcon.tsx`; all decorative icons use `aria-hidden` unless a caller supplies an accessible label. Verify no inline SVG duplicates appear in feature components. Covers FR-005, FR-013, FR-041, and FR-051.
- [ ] T024 [P] Create `src/components/layout/Logo.tsx` and `src/components/layout/CopyrightYear.tsx`: wordmark with gold/primary token treatment, default link to `/` with accessible name "myHCMUS home", light variant, and a client-only current-year island. Verify the footer year changes at presentation time rather than being build-time text. Covers FR-006 and FR-055.

**Checkpoint**: Primitives and site chrome are ready for landing composition.

## Phase 4: User Story 2 - Activity Discovery Outcomes (Priority: P2)

**Goal**: Activity discovery handles loading, success, partial, empty, error, retry, single-list, malformed, and long-content cases without degrading the rest of the page.

**Independent Test**: Drive the activity section through `success`, `partial`, `empty`, `error`, `delay`, `single-list`, `all-invalid`, and `long-content` mock scenarios; verify the correct body, announcements, retry behavior, layout, and no duplicate content.

### Tests for User Story 2

- [ ] T051 [P] [US2] Add `src/features/activities/mappers/activity.mapper.test.ts` covering grouped/single-list shapes, required/optional fields, invalid-item filtering, all-invalid errors, caps after filtering, href encoding, status mapping, timezone validation, reversed intervals, and title preservation. Verify the edge cases fail before T057. Covers FR-024, FR-027, FR-034, FR-040, and data-model mapping rules.
- [ ] T052 [P] [US2] Add `src/features/activities/services/activity.service.test.ts` covering `RealActivityService` path/signal/unwrap/map/error propagation and `MockActivityService` interface/scenario parity. Verify the test uses no environment variables. Covers contract `activity-service.md` and SC-004.
- [ ] T053 [P] [US2] Add `src/features/activities/hooks/useLandingActivities.test.tsx` covering loading, success, empty, error, retry, abort on unmount, stale response ignored, repeated retry settling once, and mapper error becoming error state. Use a deferred fake service. Verify the test fails before T063. Covers FR-039 and FR-040.
- [ ] T054 [P] [US2] Add `src/features/activities/components/ActivitiesSection.test.tsx` covering header visibility in every state, skeleton, success, empty, error with Try again, retry to loading, polite announcements, no focus jump, and no duplicate content. Verify the test fails before T066. Covers FR-020 through FR-023, FR-037 through FR-039, and FR-068.
- [ ] T055 [P] [US2] Add `src/features/activities/components/ActivityGrid.test.tsx` covering 2 featured + 3 compact, 1 featured + compact, featured-only 1/2 spanning width, upcoming-only featured-style grid up to 5/max 3 columns, and empty never rendering a grid. Verify the test fails before T061. Covers FR-024 through FR-028.
- [ ] T056 [P] [US2] Add `src/features/activities/components/ActivityCard.test.tsx` covering whole-card link/no nested link, four-line and three-line clamps, optional categories/location omitted, image fallback, status text plus non-color cue, and multi-day date rendering. Verify the test fails before T060. Covers FR-029 through FR-036.

### Implementation for User Story 2

- [ ] T057 [US2] Expand `src/features/activities/mappers/activity.mapper.ts`: detect grouped versus single-list shape, reject both/neither, filter invalid records, treat missing groups as empty, throw `InvalidLandingActivitiesError` with `INVALID_PAYLOAD` or `NO_USABLE_ITEMS`, and apply caps after filtering. Verify T051 passes. Covers FR-024, FR-027, and FR-040.
- [ ] T058 [P] [US2] Create `src/features/activities/components/ActivityStatusBadge.tsx` and `src/features/activities/components/ActivityMeta.tsx`: open/upcoming/closed labels with text plus dot/icon; date/time from `formatActivityTime`; omit missing categories/location without punctuation. Verify no raw status enum is shown. Covers FR-029 through FR-036.
- [ ] T059 [P] [US2] Create `src/features/activities/components/ActivityImage.tsx` using `next/image` with stable dimensions and an `onError`/null fallback to the local branded placeholder. Verify card dimensions do not change when the image fails. Covers FR-035 and FR-075.
- [ ] T060 [US2] Expand `src/features/activities/components/ActivityCard.tsx`: featured and compact variants, four-line/three-line clamps, exact title preservation without uppercase transformation, status only on featured, whole-card link, and no nested "View" link. Verify T056 passes. Covers FR-029 through FR-036.
- [ ] T061 [US2] Expand `src/features/activities/components/ActivityGrid.tsx` with all four layout rules and responsive reflow: featured left/compact right, featured-only spanning width, upcoming-only featured-style max-three-column grid, and no empty grid. Verify T055 passes. Covers FR-024 through FR-028 and FR-058 through FR-060.
- [ ] T062 [P] [US2] Expand `src/features/activities/components/ActivitiesSkeleton.tsx` to mirror the grouped layout, preserve height during single-list reflow, use `aria-hidden` blocks, and disable pulse under reduced motion. Verify no clipping or horizontal scroll occurs when success replaces loading. Covers FR-022, FR-023, FR-067, and FR-075.
- [ ] T063 [US2] Expand `src/features/activities/hooks/useLandingActivities.ts` to a discriminated state machine with loading/success/empty/error, request ids, abort handling, retry, stale-response protection, and no render throws. Verify T053 passes. Covers FR-039, FR-040, and FR-068.
- [ ] T064 [US2] Expand `src/features/activities/services/mock.activity.service.ts` and `activity.fixtures.ts` with `success`, `partial`, `empty`, `error`, `delay`, `single-list`, `all-invalid`, and `long-content` scenarios selected by `NEXT_PUBLIC_MOCK_ACTIVITY_SCENARIO`; simulate latency and cancellation. Verify every scenario is deterministic. Covers SC-004 and quickstart activity matrix.
- [ ] T065 [US2] Expand `src/features/activities/services/activity.service.ts` so `RealActivityService` passes the signal, unwraps `data`, maps, and propagates normalized errors; keep factory selection through `src/libs/service-mode.ts`. Verify T052 passes and no component imports the mock. Covers Constitution III/IV and contract `activity-service.md`.
- [ ] T066 [US2] Expand `src/features/activities/components/ActivitiesSection.tsx` and create `src/features/activities/config.ts` with section header, status labels, empty copy, and error copy; render exactly one body per state, keep the header visible, announce loading/empty/error politely, and move focus to the stable section heading on retry. Verify T054 passes. Covers FR-020 through FR-023, FR-037 through FR-039, and FR-068.
- [ ] T067 [US2] Integrate the expanded `ActivitiesSection` into `LandingPage` and verify the rest of the page remains usable in every activity outcome. Verify no activity error can hide or disable header, hero, highlights, services, help, or footer. Covers FR-004 and SC-010.
- [ ] T068 [US2] Run the US2 test suites and `quickstart.md` activity matrix for all eight scenarios, including repeated retry and single-list reflow. Verify no duplicate content, clipping, overlap, or horizontal scrolling. Covers US2 and SC-003/SC-004.

**Checkpoint**: US2 is independently testable across every activity outcome.

---

## Phase 5: User Story 3 - Services Require Sign-In (Priority: P3)

**Goal**: A guest can use public services, sees protected services as blurred and unreachable, and relies on the header Log In action; authenticated users see every service unlocked.

**Independent Test**: Load the services section as guest, loading, and authenticated; verify public services are usable, protected services have no destination/focus/AT exposure, loading uses the locked presentation, authenticated unlocks all, and no overlay invitation exists.

### Tests for User Story 3

- [ ] T069 [P] [US3] Add `src/features/landing/components/ServicesSection.test.tsx` covering guest, authenticated, and loading states; public links usable; protected cards blurred, inert, `aria-hidden`, no href; no overlay; stable DOM dimensions. Verify the test fails before T073. Covers FR-043 through FR-048 and SC-005.
- [ ] T070 [P] [US3] Add `src/features/landing/components/ServiceCard.test.tsx` covering locked versus unlocked rendering, external link `target`/`rel`, accessible name, no text selection, and no destination in locked DOM. Verify the test fails before T072. Covers FR-044, FR-045, and FR-049.

### Implementation for User Story 3

- [ ] T071 [US3] Update `src/features/landing/config/services.ts` with `access`, `available`, confirmed hrefs, and confirmed local icons only; keep the two pending entries out rather than inventing names or destinations. Verify the grid remains usable with four confirmed services. Covers FR-041, FR-042, and FR-050.
- [ ] T072 [US3] Update `src/features/landing/components/ServiceCard.tsx` for locked semantics: no `<a>`, no href, `inert`, `aria-hidden="true"`, no text selection, visual-only Access affordance; unlocked cards are whole-card links with accessible names and external `target="_blank"`/`rel="noopener noreferrer"`. Verify T070 passes. Covers FR-044 through FR-049.
- [ ] T073 [US3] Update `src/features/landing/components/ServicesSection.tsx` to read `useAuth()`: loading and guest use the locked presentation; authenticated unlocks all; keep identical outer dimensions; render no invitation overlay. Verify T069 passes. Covers FR-043 through FR-048.
- [ ] T074 [P] [US3] Add confirmed service logo/icon assets under `public/images/services/` and wire them through config; do not create assets for the two pending entries. Verify every confirmed service has a meaningful accessible name or decorative icon as appropriate. Covers FR-041, FR-049, and FR-050.
- [ ] T075 [US3] Integrate the gated services section into `LandingPage` and verify guest, auth-loading, and authenticated states at wide and narrow widths. Verify the header Log In action is the only sign-in path from services. Covers US3 and FR-046.
- [ ] T076 [US3] Run the US3 tests and `quickstart.md` guest/signed-in services checks; verify zero protected services are reachable by keyboard, pointer, or assistive technology for guests. Covers SC-005 and SC-006.

**Checkpoint**: US3 is independently testable and conversion-safe.

---

## Phase 6: User Story 4 - Signed-In Continuity (Priority: P4)

**Goal**: Signed-in students, organizers, and administrators can still use `/`, see a role-correct Dashboard action, and access every service without a forced redirect.

**Independent Test**: Load `/` as each signed-in role; verify no redirect, header Dashboard goes to the correct role dashboard, Get Started goes to the role dashboard, and all services are unlocked.

### Tests for User Story 4

- [ ] T077 [P] [US4] Extend `src/features/landing/components/HeroActions.test.tsx` for authenticated student/organizer/admin and auth-loading guest-safe behavior. Verify each role resolves the correct dashboard path. Covers FR-015 and SC-007.
- [ ] T078 [P] [US4] Extend `src/components/layout/SiteHeader.test.tsx` for authenticated student/organizer/admin Dashboard paths, loading skeleton, and no signed-in-only action flash. Verify the header never shows Dashboard during loading. Covers FR-008, FR-009, and SC-007.

### Implementation for User Story 4

- [ ] T079 [US4] Update `src/components/layout/SiteHeader.tsx` so the auth action renders Log In for guests, a reserved skeleton for loading, and Dashboard for authenticated users via `getDashboardPath(user.role)`; preserve the existing guest return path. Verify T078 passes. Covers FR-008 and FR-009.
- [ ] T080 [P] [US4] Update `src/features/landing/components/HeroActions.tsx` so authenticated Get Started goes directly to `getDashboardPath(user.role)` while guest/loading still uses the guest-safe login path. Verify T077 passes. Covers FR-015.
- [ ] T081 [P] [US4] Update `src/features/landing/components/ServicesSection.tsx` so authenticated users see every available service unlocked and no auth-loading locked state persists after resolution. Verify no layout shift occurs on unlock. Covers FR-047 and FR-048.
- [ ] T082 [US4] Verify `/` has no forced redirect for authenticated users and that student/organizer/admin Dashboard links resolve to `/student/dashboard`, `/organizer/dashboard`, and `/admin/dashboard`. Verify the existing proxy is not modified for this feature. Covers FR-001, FR-008, and SC-007.
- [ ] T083 [US4] Run the US4 tests and `quickstart.md` signed-in checks for all three roles. Verify no backend or auth-service refactor is included. Covers US4 and SC-007.

**Checkpoint**: US4 is independently testable for every role.

---

## Phase 7: User Story 5 - Predictable Navigation (Priority: P5)

**Goal**: Visitors can use header links, direct hashes, browser history, and the mobile drawer predictably, with active-section indication and correct focus behavior.

**Independent Test**: Use header links, direct `/#section` addresses, browser Back/Forward, keyboard-only navigation, and the mobile drawer; verify header offset, URL hash updates, active indication, modal focus containment, scroll lock, Escape/backdrop close, and focus restoration.

### Tests for User Story 5

- [ ] T084 [P] [US5] Add `src/libs/scroll.test.ts` covering `scrollToSection` hash updates, reduced-motion immediate scrolling, header offset, and `useScrollSpy` active-section selection. Verify the test fails before T086. Covers FR-010, FR-011, and FR-067.
- [ ] T085 [P] [US5] Extend `src/components/layout/SiteHeader.test.tsx` for active `aria-current`, visible non-color cue, login return path, mobile dialog focus containment, Escape/backdrop close, scroll lock, section selection, and focus restoration. Verify the test fails before T087/T088. Covers FR-010 through FR-013 and FR-069.

### Implementation for User Story 5

- [ ] T086 [US5] Create `src/libs/scroll.ts` with `scrollToSection(id)`, header-aware offset, `history.pushState`, reduced-motion handling, hash restoration on load/`hashchange`/`popstate`, and `useScrollSpy(ids)` using `IntersectionObserver`. Verify T084 passes. Covers FR-010, FR-011, FR-012, and FR-067.
- [ ] T087 [US5] Update `src/components/layout/SiteHeader.tsx` to use `useScrollSpy`, `scrollToSection`, `aria-current="location"`, a visible underline/weight cue, and `getLoginHref` with the active section. Verify T085 header/nav assertions pass. Covers FR-007, FR-010, and FR-011.
- [ ] T088 [US5] Add the mobile modal drawer to `src/components/layout/SiteHeader.tsx`: native `<dialog>`, same five links plus auth action, focus containment, background inert, scroll lock, Escape/backdrop close, section-selection close, and focus restoration to the trigger. Verify T085 mobile assertions pass. Covers FR-013 and FR-069.
- [ ] T089 [P] [US5] Update `src/features/landing/components/HeroActions.tsx` so Explore uses the configured target and `scrollToSection`/hash update while remaining configurable for a later `/activities` page. Verify the URL reflects `#activities`. Covers FR-016 and FR-010.
- [ ] T090 [US5] Add direct-hash restoration and header-aware positioning for `/#services` and every section on first load and Back/Forward; share the header-height token with `Section` scroll margin. Verify the target is not hidden under the floating header. Covers FR-010, FR-012, and SC-012.
- [ ] T091 [P] [US5] Update `src/components/layout/Logo.tsx` or its header usage so the brand returns to the top of the landing page and remains a single accessible home link. Verify the brand does not trigger a full-page reload. Covers FR-006.
- [ ] T092 [P] [US5] Update `src/components/forms/LoginForm.tsx` to accept an optional sanitized `redirectTo` prop, use `router.replace` after successful login, reject `/login` targets, and fall back to `getDashboardPath(user.role)`. Update `src/app/(public)/login/page.tsx` to read the async `searchParams` promise and pass the value; keep `src/app/test/page.tsx` working without the prop. Verify guest Log In from `#services` returns there. Covers FR-007 and plan Authentication Return Behavior.
- [ ] T093 [US5] Integrate navigation helpers, hash restoration, and the login return path into the header/hero; verify no direct `window.location` navigation or duplicated scroll logic exists. Covers FR-010 through FR-013.
- [ ] T094 [US5] Run the US5 tests and `quickstart.md` navigation/mobile-drawer checks, including direct hashes, Back/Forward, keyboard-only use, Escape, backdrop, and focus restoration. Covers US5 and SC-012.

**Checkpoint**: US5 is independently testable on desktop and narrow screens.

---

<!-- APPEND_PHASE_8 -->

- US4 test tasks T077-T078 are parallel; header/hero/services updates T079-T081 touch different files.

 ### Phase Dependencies
 
 - **Phase 1**: No dependencies; start immediately.
 - **Phase 2**: Depends on Phase 1 tokens/types; blocks landing composition.
 - **Phase 3 (US1)**: Depends on Phase 1 and Phase 2; delivers the MVP shell, grouped activity success, and all six section shells.

 - **US4 (P4)**: Uses US1 header/hero/services and shared auth state; independently testable for roles.
